chapter_title: The Explanation of the Peace, what it is; the Righ
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Five
 Mysteries


---


**
¶2:**
 You
 have asked
 me concerning
 these five essential
 acts
 of the spiritual life. In
 the natural
 world they appear dimin
ished, as
 if they were merely
 out
ward
 customs
 among
 people
,
 small
 and
 common
;
 yet in
 truth
 they are imm
ense re
alities of heaven
 and deeply
 honored
 there
. I am the one who can un
cover what
 they
 in
wardly are.
 These
 five acts
 are the hidden
 life
 of the celest
ial will
 itself
 —
 the deepest good
 in
 the human being
, which
 the
 Lord
 formed
 to
 be His
 own image
.
 That
 in
most
 good
 proceeded
 out
ward from the heav
enly states of wisdom, bearing
 these
 five acts
 within
 it. And
 when it had
 end
ured every
 assault
 of
 temptation to
 its end
, it asc
ended again
 by
 means
 of these same
 spiritual
 acts. Through
 them
 the
 heav
ens
 received it
 back into conjunction
 with the
 Divine
.

---


**¶3:** The first
 of
 these acts
 is the interior
 peace that
 all
 goods
 and truths dwelling
 in heav
enly states con
fer upon the celest
ial will when
 it begins
 its
 descent
 into temptation against
 evil
 and
 falsity. Every
 good aff
ection and every
 perception
 of truth accompan
ies that
 in
most
 willing
,
 surrounding
 it,
 best
owing upon it their
 rest
,
 their spiritual
 power, their bened
iction,
 and
 their fortification. This is the peace
 that flows
 in
 from
 heaven
 into
 the person
 who
 enters
 the
 combat
 of
 regener
ation —
 a
 peace received
 before
 the struggle
 begins
,
 given
 from
 the states
 of wisdom themselves
.


---

**¶4:**
 The first communication
 of power is what
 the Divine
 Truth
 that
 sustains all
 spiritual life best
owed
 upon the celestial will as
 it went
 forth into
 tem
ptation. This
 is
 the strength
 of
 good
 transmitted
 to the person at
 the threshold
 of combat —
 the capacity
 to act
,
 given
 as
 a
 living
 connection
 to the Source
.


---

**¶5:**
 The first conjunction
 from
 love is the embrace with
 which the Divine Truth that gives
 life
 en
fol
ded the celestial will at
 the moment of its
 separation
,
 as
 it descended into the
 states
 of temptation. Indeed
, every
 good and every
 truth dwelling
 in the
 heavenly
 states also
 sought
 to enf
old it —
 all
 of
 them:
 the guard
ians of the internal
 church
, and
 all
 the kind
red aff
ections belonging
 to its
 spiritual
 household. They en
folded the
 in
most will in
 an
 embrace of deep
 aff
ection and love as
 it departed
 from
 them,
 accompanying it out
ward, joining
 themselves
 to it through
 the bond
 of mutual acknowledg
ment.

---

**¶
6:** The first act
 of hum
ility is the submission that
 the celestial will itself
 performed
 as
 it descended
 into the
 lower
 regions of the
 mind
.
 It
 bent
 the
 natural
 will
 into
 reve
rence, making
 its
 acknowledg
ment before
 the Divine Truth
 Itself, and
 before
 all the heavenly states
 belonging
 to the household of its
 origin
,
 entre
ating from
 them a
 power to accomp
any it as
 it went forth into
 combat
.
 This is the will
's
 own recognition
 that no
 power against
 evil origin
ates in
 itself
,
 but only from the Divine.

---


**¶7:** The first
 transmission
 of authority
 is what
 the Divine Truth
 that sust
ains life
 con
ferred upon the head
 —
 the in
most understanding
 —
 of
 the celestial will.
 She
 equipped
 it with
 tru
ths for combat
 and
 made it strong
. She commun
icated her power into
 it
, and
 sent
 it into
 the struggle
. It descended.
 It completed its warfare
 against
 the great organized
 forms
 of evil and
 
enmity.

---

**
¶8:** By these five spiritual
 acts and these five interior
 re
alities,
 the celestial will came forth from the
 heavenly states of wisdom against evil
 and falsity. It subd
ued them. It prev
ailed over
 them by means
 of these very
 acts.

---

**¶
9:** And
 when it
 asc
ended out
 of tem
ptation, it entered
 into
 the heav
enly kingdom —
 the household
 of its own
 spiritual
 kind
red —
 by means
 of these same
 five interior
 re
alities.


---

**¶10:**
 The peace with
 which it ascended is the peace that
 the Divine Call
 gave
 to it —
 the awak
ening truth
 sent
 forth
 from the Divine Love
 Itself. That
 call
 reached
 it
 even
 in the midst of fals
ity and delivered
 to
 it rest
.
 And
 the
 peace with which it had
 first
 descended is the very
 same peace by
 which it was
 raised
 from the struggle —
 for
 Divine
 peace is one
,
 unchanged
 by
 circumst
ance, present
 both
 at
 the threshold
 of temptation and at its resolution
. Therefore
, in
 correspondence
 with the hidden
 reality
 of that peace which
 the Divine
 Call gave the
 celestial will, the
 out
ward custom
 of peace
 among
 people
 came
 into
 being. It was recognized
 and received
 among all the goods that
 proceed
 from the Divine Love.

---


**¶11:** The
 second communication of power is what the Divine
 Proceeding —
 the Living
 Activity
 of
 the Spirit
 — gave to the celestial will when
 it drew
 it upward out
 of temptation. In
 correspondence
 with the hidden reality of that conjunction
, the
 outward custom of extending
 the
 hand arose
 among
 human
 beings, as
 they offer
 it to their companions, honored
 and rev
ered.


---

**¶12:**
 The second conjunction
 from love is the embrace with which the
 Divine Love
 Itself and
 the Divine Truth that sustains all
 life enfolded the celestial will
 when it ascended from the struggle.
 This
 same
 act
 of conjunction now
 occurs among people
 as
 they embrace
 their
 companions —
 whether depar
ting from the
 states
 familiar
 to them and
 becoming
 distant from
 those
 they love, or approaching one another once
 more —
 all
 in correspondence
 with the reality
 of what
 the
 celestial will experienced
.

---

**¶13
:** The second act of humility is
 the submission
 that the celest
ial will performed
 after
 its
 del
iverance —
 this
 time offered
 again
 before
 the Divine Truth Itself, and before
 all
 the blessed
 heavenly states and all the real
ms of wisdom
 and the
 whole
 of heaven
,
 when
 the Divine Love and
 the Divine Truth that sustains life
 brought
 the
 regener
ated will upward from the depths of
 temptation. In
 correspondence with the hidden
 reality of this
 second
 hum
ility, the outward custom of o
beisance arose
 —
 the one
 that occurs among
 people
 as they show
 reve
rence to one another, honoring their
 companions.

---

**¶
14:** The second transmission of authority is
 this
: When the Divine
 Proceeding drew
 the celestial will upward from the
 conflict
, it delivered
 it
 from
 all the surging fals
ities that
 had
 overwhel
med it. It raised
 it up and
 gave it rest
 in the great
 heavenly states of wisdom that
 belong to the household of its spiritual
 kind
red. It established
 it firmly
 in
 the presence of the Divine Love,
 the Lord of all
 things. The
 celest
ial will received this great communication
 of power and
 was appointed
 to lead
 all
 who
 share
 its
 good
 in
 the new state
 of heaven.
 And
 in
 correspondence with the hidden reality of this transmission
 of authority, the outward custom arose
 among people
 of
 the laying
 on of hands — whereby
 those
 who possess
 greater
 good
 communicate
 power
 and
 responsibility
 to those who are
 lesser,
 author
izing them to serve
.


---

**¶15:**
 These five interior
 realities and these five spiritual
 acts originated
 first
 in the Divine
 itself
. Humanity
 was
 then
 instruct
ed in
 them,
 and people
 instit
uted them out
wardly among
 themselves
 as
 customs
 and
 
rites. But these re
alities never
 existed among
 the organized
 forms
 of evil and falsity.
 They have
 no origin
 in darkness
, no
 root
 in the
 self
hood
.
 They are purely from good.


---

**¶20:**
 And
 once more
: At the time of a
 person's departure
 from
 the natural
 body
, the Divine Human
 Form
 comes
 forth before
 them and
 re
deems them from fals
ity into
 wisdom
,
 from evil
 into good.
 This
 Divine
 Human Form calms the person with the
 conjunction
 of love and with
 its
 own
 still
ness, fre
eing the
 soul from the terror
 of the
 evil
 spirits that had
 bes
ieged the
 natural
 life
. By the
 aspect
 and
 image of this Form
, the heart of the faithful
 one who has
 departed
 from the
 natural
 body is
 made
 tran
quil. Thereafter
, the truth
 bearing
 the acknowledgment of victory
 extends to the
 soul
 the
 power
 of good.
 It
 draws the soul upward out of the
 abyss of the natural and
 sens
ual person, and receives
 it in
ward
 through
 the bond
 of love
 and
 conjunction
. That soul makes
 its
 acknowledg
ment of
 hum
ility before its
 deliv
erer —
 which
 is this Divine Human Form.
 And at
 that
 very
 moment, the
 soul
 is perfected and increased according to its
 reception
 of good
,
 in
 the household of the living,
 among
 all
 the goods and truths,
 all
 the rev
eal
ers
 and
 the chosen. And it receives the crown
 of wisdom from
 love
 and
 the glory
 of eternal
 life.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: You have questioned me about these five lessons. Now, they are displayed in the world as miniatures, being made little; and yet indeed they are great and honoured. I am the one who can reveal to you their mystery! So, these five signs are the mystery of the First Man. He came forth with them from the aeon of light. Also, when he finished his contest, he went up with these good signs. They received him into the aeons of light.

The first peace is the one that the gods and the angels in the land of light gave to the First Man; when he comes out against the enemy. The gods and the angels were walking with him; escorting him, giving to him their peace and power, and their blessing and fortification. This is the first peace that the gods and the angels gave to the First Man; as he comes forth from the aeon of light.
The first right hand is the one that the Mother of Life gave to the First Man; when he comes out to the contest.

The first kiss is this one with which the Mother of Life embraced the First Man; as he separates from her, coming down to the contest. Even all the gods and the angels who are in the aeons of light were making to embrace him! [They were making to embrace him;] all of them also, and the church tutelaries (?), and the kinsfolk who belong to the household of his people. They were making to embrace him as [he] separates from them, accompanying him out, embracing him with the kiss of affection and love.

The first salutation is the salutation with which the First Man made obeisance; when he comes out [to the depths] below. He was bending his knees, making obeisance to the God of truth, and all the aeons [of light] who belong to the household of his people; entreating them for a power to escort him, as he comes forth.

The first laying on of hands is the one that the Mother of Life bequeathed upon the head of the First Man. She armed him and made him mighty. She laid hands on him, and sent him to the battle. He descended. He completed his struggle with the great powers and the enmity.
By the[se] five signs and these five myst[e]ri[es] the First Man came forth from the aeons of light against the enemy. He humbled him. He was victorious against him by them.
Also, when he ascended from the war, he came in to the kingdom of the household of his people by these five mysteries!

The peace with which [he ascen]ded is the peace that the summons gave to him, [w]hen it was sent forth from the [Fa]ther of Life. It gave him the peace in the world of darkness. Also, that peace with which he descended is th[e sam]e as the one with which he ascended from the struggle! Therefore, appropriate to the my[s]tery of that peace, which the summons gave the First Man, did this peace here and now come about. It was named and heard among the powers of the Father.

Again, this second right hand is the one that the Living Spirit gave the First Man, when he [brou]ght him upward out from the struggle. Appropriate to [the] mystery [of t]hat right hand this right hand has come about; the one that occurs in the [midst of] mankind, as they give it to their companions, [it b]eing honoured and [glorified among them.]

Also, this second kiss is the one with which the [Father o]f Life and the Mother of the living embraced the First Man, when he ascended from the struggle. Again, this kiss occurs among mankind, as they make to embrace their companions with it; whether then [they] go away from home and be far from their friends, or else [if] they approach one another, according to the mystery of (the First Man).

[The] second salutation with which the First Man made obeisance [is the one that he made this] time to the God of truth and [to all] the blessed aeons and al[l] the aeons [of light and the] whole [land] of light, whe[n] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living brought the Man upward from the abyss of the struggle. Appropriate to the mystery of the second salutation this salutation has come about; this one that occurs today in the midst of mankind, as they make obeisance to one another, doing an honour to their companions.

The second laying on of hands is this: When the Living Spirit brought the First Man upward from the war, he saved him from all the surging waves. He brought him upward, he gave him ease in the great aeons of light, which belong to the household of his people. He set [him] firmly before the Father, the Lord of the totality. He received this great laying on of hands that he may become leader of his brethren in the new aeon. Again, appropriate to the mystery of the second laying on of hands, this laying on of hands has come about; the one that occurs in the midst of mankind as they lay hands on one another, the great giving authority to the lesser.

These five mysteries and these five signs came about first in the divine. Mankind has been taught them; and they have instituted them in their midst [as customs and signs; but] these mysteries were not at the beginning amongst the powers of darkness.

Once again: At the time of their coming forth, the Light Form shall come forth before them; and she redeems them from the darkness to the light[, from evil to good.] This Light Form calms the person, with the kiss and her quiet, from fear of the demons w[ho de]stroy his body. By her asp[ec]t and her image [the] heart of the elect one, who is come forth from his bo[d]y, shall be calm for [him]. Afterwards, the angel who h[o]lds the victory prize extends to him the right hand. And it draws him out of the abyss of his body, and accepts him in with the [k]iss and love. That soul shall make obeisance to its red[eem]er, who is this Light Form. And also, at the inst[ant when the hands are laid upon him,] he shall be perfected and increased according to [the measure of his light] in the household of the living ones, with the go[ds] and the angel[s] and all the apostles and the chosen. [An]d he receives the crown [of light and the] glory in the life for ever.
